sopChecklistItems.title: Store lights & showcase display spotlights powered ON
Boutique HVAC set to chocolate ambient 18°C-20°C
Glass display surfaces sanitized with lint-free microfiber
Register drawer cash float counted and verified (₹5,000 baseline)
Front entrance and entryway welcome mat photo confirmation
Inspect dark chocolate displays for sugar or fat bloom (white haze)
Verify all flavor descriptive gold cards and allergen labels are upright
Ensure minimum 5 units per displayed SKU on front tiers
Upload wide-angle photograph of central display counter
Display Showcase Plinth Temperature (Target: 14°C - 16°C)
Cold Storage Refrigerator #1 (Target: 4°C - 7°C)
Humidity reader check (Must remain below 55% RH)
Photo of digital thermometer readout display
Tongs, spatulas, and display trays sanitized in hot water
Handwash station restocked with antibacterial soap and paper towels
Waste bins emptied and sanitized liners installed
Hygiene and grooming standard verified for on-duty associates
High-value truffle trays transferred to humidity-controlled night vault
Display lights and spotlight tracks turned OFF
POS daily batch closure slip generated and settled
Secondary cash safe locked with dual-key custody
Main security shutters locked and alarm system armed
Physical count of all gift hampers and praline boxes completed
Discrepancies exceeding ±1 unit flagged for supervisor inquiry
Daily count sheet signed by store manager
Check manufacturing date batch stamps on all refrigerated truffles
Remove any brownies or cookies within 24 hours of best-before date
Record any expired units into daily wastage log
Test transaction ping on primary and backup EDC card machines
Verify dynamic UPI display QR standee is clean and readable
Ensure minimum 5 thermal receipt paper rolls in counter storage
Log itemized count of broken or heat-damaged items
Log complimentary tasting samples distributed to customers
Manager sign-off on wastage write-off log with photo
Match total day sales on POS with bank gateway settlements
Verify all stock movement entries posted before closing the session
Submit end-of-day discrepancy inquiry if variance exceeds ₹200
